page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Expose the minimum configuration surface needed to understand and operate Extraction Range safely.

states.description: Appearance, language and enabled notification preferences are available.
No independent settings data load is required; shell preferences initialize before the page is shown.
No additional scenario-specific preferences are configured.
If optional notification controls are not enabled, appearance and language remain usable.
Preferences are browser-local; the page does not present remote freshness.
Preference changes do not call a remote service; a locale load error is surfaced by the UI framework.
